name: google-deepmind_alignet/AGENT.python.tools.md

google-deepmind_alignet/bv_utils.py.merge_params_loaded_inited: merge loaded checkpoint parameters with initialized model parameters using merge_params
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_utils.py.load_params_from_checkpoint: load model parameters from an npz or tensorstore checkpoint file with load_params
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_utils.py.tree_get_by_path: get a nested pytree value by its flattened key path like a/b/c using tree_get
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_utils.py.tsload_arrays_from_disk: load tensorstore-based array trees from disk with optional regex filtering via tsload
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_utils.py.npload_numpy_file: load a numpy npz or npy file and return an ndarray or dict using npload

google-deepmind_alignet/bv_vit.py.build_vit_model: build a Vision Transformer model using the Model factory with a variant string like B/16
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_vit.py.decode_variant_params: decode a ViT variant string like B/32 into width, depth, mlp_dim, and num_heads params
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_vit.py.create_sincos_posemb: create 2D sincos positional embeddings for a given grid height, width, and embedding dimension
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_vit.py.resample_positional_embeddings: resample positional embeddings from an old grid size to a new one for high-res fine-tuning
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_vit.py.load_vit_checkpoint: load ViT model parameters from a checkpoint file with automatic format conversion and posemb resampling

google-deepmind_alignet/bv_wrapper.py.build_vit_model: build a Flax Linen ViT model using the Model class with a specified variant like B/16
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_wrapper.py.load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained Big Vision weights into a Kauldron TrainState using the Loader class transform method
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_wrapper.py.create_triplet_wrapper: create a TripletWrapper module that wraps any model to produce triplet logits for contrastive learning
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_wrapper.py.review_loader_transform: review the Loader transform method to understand how it merges pretrained weights with random init params
google-deepmind_alignet/bv_wrapper.py.summarize_triplet_output: summarize the TripletOutput TypedDict which defines logits, pre_logits, and triplet_logits output shapes

google-deepmind_alignet/data.py.create_AligNetTriplets_from_args: create an AligNetTriplets dataset from a root directory, split, transform, and sampling arguments
google-deepmind_alignet/data.py.load_AligNetTriplets_data: load the cached npz data containing triplet indices and similarities from a dataset path
google-deepmind_alignet/data.py.access_AligNetTriplets_imagenet_ds: access the cached ImageNet2012 TensorFlow dataset source for the current split
google-deepmind_alignet/data.py.get_AligNetTriplets_record: get a triplet record by index containing images, labels, file names, and similarities
google-deepmind_alignet/data.py.get_AligNetTriplets_length: get the total number of triplet records in the AligNetTriplets dataset

google-deepmind_alignet/losses.py.build_contrastive_triplet_loss: build a ContrastiveTripletLoss to compute contrastive triplet loss from logits with configurable tau and normalization
google-deepmind_alignet/losses.py.build_kld_triplet_loss: build a KLDTripletLoss to compute KL divergence loss between predicted and target similarity distributions
google-deepmind_alignet/losses.py.build_jsd_triplet_loss: build a JSDTripletLoss to compute Jensen-Shannon divergence loss between predicted and target similarity distributions
google-deepmind_alignet/losses.py.review_dot_products: review the _dot_products function that calculates inner products between all pairs of triplet embeddings
google-deepmind_alignet/losses.py.refactor_neg_entropy: refactor the _neg_entropy function to compute negative entropy of a probability distribution with zero-safe handling

google-deepmind_alignet/metrics.py.create_TripletAccuracy_metric: create a TripletAccuracy metric instance to measure fraction of triplets where the (i,j) pair is most similar
google-deepmind_alignet/metrics.py.use_TripletAccuracy_get_state: use TripletAccuracy get_state to compute triplet similarity correctness from logits and optional mask tensors
google-deepmind_alignet/metrics.py.review_TripletAccuracy_class: review the TripletAccuracy class that extends kd.metrics.Metric for evaluating triplet embedding similarity
google-deepmind_alignet/metrics.py.summarize_TripletAccuracy_get_state: summarize the get_state method which computes dot products between triplet pairs and checks if (i,j) is most similar
